displayTitle: The Mos Eisley Cantina Pop-Up Book
synopsis: The Mos Eisley Cantina Pop-Up Book is a young reader book published by Little Brown in 1996. The book features some of the patrons of the Mos Eisley Cantina, providing back-stories originating in Tales From the Mos Eisley Cantina. Each vignette ends with a sentence explaining the role that the cantina plays in that character's life.
title: The Mos Eisley Cantina Pop-Up Book
